LanguageData.SSFTest_BearForm.label: bear form
LanguageData.SSFTest_BearForm.description: Test bear shapeshift. Full animal transformation. Replaces body texture with bear, adjusts stats, grants hediffs.
LanguageData.SSFTest_BearWarriorForm.label: bear warrior form
LanguageData.SSFTest_BearWarriorForm.description: Test bear warrior shapeshift. Stats enhanced while keeping equipment. Bear sound override.
LanguageData.SSFTest_SheepForm.label: sheep form
LanguageData.SSFTest_SheepForm.description: Test sheep shapeshift. Combat ability lost, voluntary revert disabled.
LanguageData.SSFTest_DarkKnightForm.label: dark knight form
LanguageData.SSFTest_DarkKnightForm.description: Dark knight transformation. Spawns dedicated plasteel plate armor and longsword. Existing gear moves to inventory. Spawned gear is destroyed on revert.
LanguageData.SSFTest_BeastkinForm.label: beastkin form
LanguageData.SSFTest_BeastkinForm.description: Beastkin form. Adds ear/tail graphics, tests various ranged verbs. Can perform 2nd-stage transformation to full beast while in beastkin form.
LanguageData.SSFTest_FullBeastForm.label: full beast form
LanguageData.SSFTest_FullBeastForm.description: Full beast form. Can only transform from beastkin state (ability granted via beastkin form's addAbilities).
LanguageData.SSFTest_GuardianForm.label: guardian form
LanguageData.SSFTest_GuardianForm.description: Guardian form. Maintained while possessing magic stone or guardian's mark. Tests large shadow and portrait scaling.
LanguageData.SSFTest_PhantomForm.label: phantom form
LanguageData.SSFTest_PhantomForm.description: Phantom form. Semi-transparent head, thin body type. Firefighting disabled. FX delay test.
LanguageData.SSFTest_RaceLockedForm.label: race locked form
LanguageData.SSFTest_RaceLockedForm.description: Human-only enhancement form. Apparel change locked, weapons freely swappable. Fixed head type.
